summary.intent: Integrate teammates' remote changes into the local repo, keep portal data out of git, tidy local data, move work onto its own branch, and then drive supplier email threads with Boise Semiconductor (IT contact request, EXW confirmation, a fixed-format status template) for a hackathon watcher/dashboard project.
summary.outcome: Rebased 4 local commits onto origin/main without conflicts, confirmed all data is gitignored under data/, deleted ~96 MB of verified-duplicate leftovers, pushed the commits on branch jonas/watcher-dashboard, sent Boise two emails (IT contact ask, then EXW confirmation plus the status template), and committed a supplier-status-format spec in docs/.

repo: All portal and supplier data lives under gitignored data/: store/ (version store by checksum plus SQLite log, source of truth), portal/ (readable mirror), archive.zip (14:02 baseline), inbox/, outbox/, notes/, logs/.
Team workflow calls for rebase on pull (git pull --rebase); plain git pull fails on divergent branches.
.env.example must stay because the watcher reads its config from it; Farhan's merge restored it deliberately.
Farhan's merge added project skills strategize and tell_me plus challenge_docs/.
No git commit or Entire checkpoint contains portal data or full file listings; checkpoints only hold file counts, so history can't be backdated before the 14:02 baseline.
Docs in the repo should use invented example values rather than real supplier data.
The analysis agent needs an Anthropic API key in .env; 16 file versions are pending analysis until then.
workflow: Before deleting gitignored leftovers, verify by checksum that every file exists in the version store.
Moving unpushed commits to a new branch and resetting local main to origin/main keeps the team's main untouched while sharing the work.
Supplier-side agents only see their own email thread, so every thread must restate relevant state (e.g. earlier confirmations) rather than referencing other threads.
Background polling tasks work well for waiting on supplier replies (Boise typically replies in ~4 minutes).

friction: git pull failed on divergent branches and needed an explicit rebase.
Farhan's branch was force-pushed, which complicated searching for older history.
No teammate or git source had portal state earlier than the 14:02 baseline, so the requested history restore wasn't possible.
Boise's agent lacks cross-thread memory, so it kept the shipment on hold and asked for the EXW confirmation to be resent.
Boise did not provide an IT or operations contact; Megan said she must check internally first.
Deleting leftovers moved a previously referenced path (data/drops/1437/... to data/portal/suppliers/...).
open_items: Wait for Boise's reply to the template and EXW confirmation mail (background check running).
Put an Anthropic API key in .env so the analysis agent can process the 16 pending file versions.
Build the act step: action proposals per finding, one-click approval, send via Gmail, per-order supplier status tracking.
Run the Nowak art book order as the first real end-to-end run (offer expires after 24 h).
Make the watcher parse the Soony supplier status v1 format from the inbox.
Agree direction and task split with the team and get Felix's 15:15 quote for the pitch.
Ask Maren at 09:00 office hours about the cost of a missing copy for the business case.
Set up deployment for the hand-in (tunnel or teammate hosting), and prepare the deck and 3-minute video by 11:30 Sunday.
Open a PR from jonas/watcher-dashboard into main when ready; the spec commit on the branch is not yet confirmed as pushed.
